items.name: Cooking oil
items.preparation: implied by sauteed/roasted vegetables and seared meat, absorbed into the food

scale_cues: White square dinner plate assumed about 25-26 cm across; food occupies roughly the upper third of the plate. Green bean length (about 8-10 cm each) used as a secondary size check. No cutlery or hand in frame.
assumptions: Only the centre plate is logged; the partially visible side plate at left (olives, cherry tomatoes, shredded carrot) is treated as a separate dish and excluded.
Meat is assumed to be beef steak of moderate fat content; it could be another red meat such as lamb or liver.
The topping on the meat is assumed to be a small amount of crumb and tomato, included in the meat's mass and calories.
The brown pieces under the rice are assumed to be mushrooms; they could be small pieces of meat.
Cooking oil is not directly visible and is estimated from the sheen and preparation style.
Food depth is estimated from a single overhead view, so mass of the piled items is uncertain.
